explanation: Haiti's revolution, begun by enslaved people in 1791, made it the first independent state in Latin America. Mexico's war, launched in 1810, ended in 1821.

claims.text: Haiti declared its independence from France on 1 January 1804.
Mexico won independence from Spain in September 1821.
The Haitian Revolution began with an uprising of enslaved people in 1791.
Haiti was the first independent state in Latin America.
Mexico's war of independence began in 1810.
